packageRules.description: myq_local/requirements.txt is exported from uv.lock, and Renovate cannot run uv export, so an automatic Python update would leave the add-on image's hashed requirements stale. Update Python dependencies with uv lock plus uv export.
community/050dctwf preserves a hardware-tested upstream snapshot; it is not updated.
Add-on base images wait 30 days after release.
